cats.d: Pour, press the auto program, walk away. BlendSense does the timing.
Spoonable smoothie bowls. Less liquid, more toppings.
Slushies, frappés and shakes. Max Crush turns ice to snow.
Salsa, pesto, hummus. Use the chop programs for texture.
Silky soups from cooked veg, plus a no-cook gazpacho.
Pancakes, crêpes and muffins blended in one jug.

recipes.title: Strawberry banana
recipes.blurb: The classic. Thick, sweet and ready in a minute.
steps: Add milk, yogurt and banana, then the frozen strawberries. Liquids first, then soft ingredients, then frozen fruit and ice on top.
Lock the lid and run the auto program.
Taste. Too thick? Add a splash of milk and pulse.
recipes.healthier: Use unsweetened almond milk, skip the honey and add a handful of spinach. You won't taste it.

recipes.title: Green machine
recipes.blurb: Spinach you can't taste, thanks to mango and pineapple.
steps: Water and spinach go in first so the greens blend smooth.
Add banana, mango, pineapple and lime.
Run the auto program. No leafy bits left.
recipes.healthier: Already light. Add a scoop of Greek yogurt or protein to keep you full longer.

recipes.title: Peanut butter cup
recipes.blurb: Chocolate, banana and peanut butter. A dessert that counts as breakfast.
steps: Milk, peanut butter and cocoa first.
Add banana, protein and ice.
Run auto. Pour into tall glasses.
recipes.healthier: Use powdered peanut butter and unsweetened cocoa to cut the fat by about half.

recipes.title: Tropical sunrise
recipes.blurb: Mango, pineapple, coconut and orange. Holiday in a glass.
steps: Pour coconut milk and orange juice in first.
Add the fruit.
Run auto and serve with a straw.
recipes.healthier: Use light coconut milk and water instead of orange juice, and add half a cup of spinach.

recipes.title: Berry oat breakfast
recipes.blurb: Oats make it filling enough to replace breakfast.
steps: Add milk and oats and let them sit 2 minutes to soften.
Add yogurt, banana, chia and berries.
Run auto.
recipes.healthier: Already filling. Use unsweetened milk and skip any sweetener; the banana is enough.

recipes.title: Ginger glow
recipes.blurb: Peach, carrot, orange and fresh ginger. Bright and zingy.
steps: Juice, carrot and ginger go in first.
Add peaches and ice.
Run auto twice if you want it ultra smooth.
recipes.healthier: Already light. Swap the orange juice for water and add a squeeze of lemon to keep it bright.

recipes.title: Açaí bowl
recipes.blurb: Thick enough to hold granola, banana and berries on top.
ing: Toppings: granola, sliced banana, berries, honey
steps: Break up the açaí packs. Add milk, then banana, berries and açaí.
Run Thick. Use the tamper or stop and scrape if it stalls. Add milk 1 tbsp at a time only if needed.
Spoon into bowls and pile on toppings.
recipes.healthier: Use unsweetened açaí packs, go light on granola and skip the honey drizzle.

recipes.title: Pitaya pink bowl
recipes.blurb: Pink, sweet and spoonable. Use frozen dragon fruit or strawberries.
ing: 1½ cups frozen dragon fruit or strawberries
steps: Coconut milk first, then all the frozen fruit.
Run Thick, scraping once if needed.
Top and eat right away.
recipes.healthier: Top with seeds and fresh fruit instead of granola, and skip any syrup.

recipes.title: Green protein bowl
recipes.blurb: Avocado makes it creamy. Protein makes it lunch.
steps: Milk and spinach first, then avocado, protein, banana and pineapple.
Run Thick.
Top with seeds and sliced fruit.
recipes.healthier: Already balanced. Use half an avocado instead of a whole one if you're watching calories.

recipes.title: Chocolate PB nice cream
recipes.blurb: Bananas only, no ice cream maker needed. Soft-serve texture.
steps: Add milk, then bananas, cocoa and peanut butter.
Run Thick, scraping down once.
Eat soft or freeze 30 minutes to scoop.
recipes.healthier: Skip the extra peanut butter and use powdered PB; bananas bring plenty of sweetness.

recipes.title: Strawberry lemonade slush
recipes.blurb: Bright pink, icy and perfect for hot afternoons.
steps: Lemonade and lemon juice first, then strawberries and ice.
Run Max Crush.
Serve with spoons and straws.
recipes.healthier: Use unsweetened sparkling water and fresh lemon juice instead of lemonade.

recipes.title: Iced mocha frappé
recipes.blurb: Coffee-shop frappé for a fraction of the price.
ing: 1 cup cold brew or chilled strong coffee
2 tbsp chocolate syrup or cocoa + honey
steps: Coffee, milk and chocolate first, ice on top.
Run Max Crush.
Top with whipped cream.
recipes.healthier: Use unsweetened cocoa with a teaspoon of honey instead of syrup, and skip the whipped cream.

recipes.title: Cookies & cream shake
recipes.blurb: Thick milkshake with cookie bits in every sip.
steps: Add milk, then ice cream.
Blend on speed 6 for 20 seconds until smooth.
Add the cookies and pulse 3 times so you keep chunks.
recipes.healthier: Use Greek yogurt and frozen banana instead of ice cream, and just two cookies crushed on top.

recipes.title: Watermelon mint frosty
recipes.blurb: Just frozen watermelon, lime and mint. No added sugar.
steps: Water, lime and mint first, watermelon on top.
Run Max Crush.
Serve right away.
notes: Freeze watermelon chunks flat on a tray so they don't clump.
recipes.healthier: Already a no-added-sugar treat. Nothing to change.

recipes.title: Restaurant-style salsa
recipes.blurb: Chunky, fresh and better than the jar.
steps: Add onion, garlic and jalapeño first, then tomatoes, cilantro, lime and salt.
Run Large Chop. For smoother salsa run Small Chop.
Rest 15 minutes so the flavours mingle.
recipes.healthier: Already light. Serve with sliced cucumber and peppers instead of chips.

recipes.title: Basil pesto
recipes.blurb: Bright green, garlicky and ready in two minutes.
ing: ⅓ cup pine nuts or walnuts
steps: Add oil, garlic, nuts and cheese, then basil on top.
Run Mince. Scrape down and pulse if needed.
Season with lemon and salt. Toss with pasta or spread on toast.
recipes.healthier: Use half the oil plus a splash of pasta water, and half the cheese.

recipes.title: Silky hummus
recipes.blurb: Whip it longer than you think for cloud-smooth hummus.
ing: 3–4 tbsp chickpea liquid or ice water
steps: Add lemon, tahini, garlic and liquid first, then chickpeas.
Blend on speed 6 for a full minute, scraping once.
Drizzle with oil and paprika.
recipes.healthier: Already healthy. Use less oil on top and serve with veg sticks.

recipes.title: Green goddess dressing
recipes.blurb: Herby, creamy, and makes any salad disappear.
steps: Add everything, yogurt first.
Blend on speed 5 until pale green and smooth.
Thin with water to pour.
recipes.healthier: Already light. Use nonfat Greek yogurt to cut the fat further.

recipes.title: Roasted tomato basil soup
recipes.blurb: Blend hot soup in batches, never filled past halfway.
steps: Roast tomatoes, onion and garlic at 400°F for 35 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes. Blend with stock and basil, half at a time, starting on speed 4 and going up to 8. Leave the lid cap vented.
Reheat, stir in cream, season.
notes: Hot liquids expand. Fill the pitcher no more than halfway and start slow.
recipes.healthier: Skip the cream; blend in half a can of white beans for creaminess and extra protein.

recipes.title: Butternut squash soup
recipes.blurb: Velvety, sweet and cosy. No cream needed.
steps: Roast squash cut-side down at 400°F for 40 minutes, then scoop out.
Blend squash, carrot, onion, stock and spices in batches, slow then fast.
Reheat and season.
recipes.healthier: Already dairy-free and light. Use low-sodium stock.

recipes.title: Chilled gazpacho
recipes.blurb: No-cook Spanish tomato soup. Best ice cold on hot days.
steps: Roughly chop the veg. Add everything to the pitcher.
Blend on speed 8 until smooth.
Chill 1 hour. Drizzle with oil to serve.
recipes.healthier: Already a raw-veg soup. Go easy on the oil drizzle.

recipes.title: Fluffy blender pancakes
recipes.blurb: Everything in the jug, pour straight onto the pan.
steps: Add milk, egg and butter first, then dry ingredients.
Blend on speed 4 for 15 seconds. Rest 5 minutes.
Pour circles onto a hot buttered pan. Flip when bubbles pop.
recipes.healthier: Swap half the flour for oat flour and top with berries instead of syrup.

recipes.title: Banana oat pancakes
recipes.blurb: Three ingredients, no flour, naturally sweet.
steps: Add bananas and eggs, then oats and baking powder.
Blend on speed 5 until smooth. Rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Cook small pancakes on medium-low; they brown fast.
recipes.healthier: Already flour-free. Top with fruit and Greek yogurt instead of syrup.

recipes.title: Easy crêpes
recipes.blurb: Thin, lacy French crêpes. Blending means zero lumps.
steps: Blend everything on speed 4 for 10 seconds.
Rest 15 minutes.
Swirl ¼ cup into a hot buttered pan. Flip after 1 minute.
recipes.healthier: Use half whole-wheat flour and fill with fruit and yogurt instead of chocolate spread.

recipes.title: Creamsicle smoothie
recipes.blurb: Orange and vanilla, like the ice-pop. Dessert vibes for breakfast.
steps: Add liquids first, then fruit, yogurt and ice.
Run the Smoothie auto program (BlendSense).
Pour and serve.
recipes.healthier: Use plain Greek yogurt and a drop of vanilla instead of vanilla yogurt.

recipes.title: PB & berry protein smoothie
recipes.blurb: Tastes like a PB&J, keeps you full till lunch.
steps: Add milk, then everything else.
Run the Smoothie auto program.
Add a splash more milk if it's too thick.
recipes.healthier: Use powdered peanut butter to cut the fat in half.

recipes.title: Mixed berry smoothie bowl
recipes.blurb: Thick, purple and spoonable. Top it like a sundae.
ing: Granola, sliced banana and chia to top
steps: Add milk, then frozen fruit.
Run the Thick program, using the tamper if needed.
Scoop into bowls and add toppings.
recipes.healthier: Go light on granola and add nuts or seeds instead.

recipes.title: Strawberry banana protein bowl
recipes.blurb: Classic flavor, extra protein, very filling.
steps: Add milk and yogurt, then the rest.
Run the Thick program.
Top with fresh strawberries and seeds.
recipes.healthier: Already a strong pick. Use unsweetened protein powder.

recipes.title: Thick chocolate milkshake
recipes.blurb: Old-school diner shake. Spoon optional.
steps: Add milk, then ice cream and cocoa.
Blend on speed 6 for 20 seconds, just until smooth.
Pour and top with whipped cream.
recipes.healthier: Blend a frozen banana, cocoa and milk instead of ice cream.
